about: Modwerk source-only voice-dac package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/voice-dac.

mods.title: Voice DAC
mods.summary: Routes the eight voices to the main mix through the DAC and adds a per-voice filter, transient shaper and polarity on a second FILTER page.
mods.description: Voice DAC lets the eight voices leave the analog main bus and reach it again through the DAC, where each voice is processed after its analog filter and amp. With GLOBAL > AUDIO ROUTING > DAC SUM on, FILTER pressed twice opens DAC FILTER: a digital filter per voice (FRQ, RES, TYP OFF, LP2, LP1, BP, HP1, HP2, BS or PK, and DEP, the depth of the effect), a transient shaper (ATK and SUS) and polarity (POL). The values are kept with the sound and DAC SUM with the project's global slot. From 1.4 the page shows only the knobs the selected sound's TYP uses. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0013-voice-dac at his update 3a98e23, with his code unchanged apart from the storage port and the page entries, which now go through core-ar2's page tables.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: Not run on a unit on Modwerk's base. As reported by the author, on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, build V6A4 (core-ar2 0.6 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports, this module at 1.4, plus analoghealth for remote keys) passed DAC FILTER through every TYP, the page following TYP and the track, and BD's settings back after SAVE KIT, a power cycle and RELOAD (2026-10-23). This package's own bytes, and the Modwerk base, have not been flashed.
